lines: Black played 32% of snaps and got 9.3 carries per game over the last 3 games, up from 30% and 8.5 on the season.
He has a 4% target share, and the coach said Black will keep a complementary role behind McCaffrey by design.
Our Wk 12 projection is 7.7 PPR points, 49th among RBs, against SEA, who allow the 23rd-most PPR points per game to RBs.
